ORDER
1. The Fiscal Services Division of the Office of the Trial Court Administrator for the Fourth
Judicial District is responsible for collecting and managing in excess of$17,000,000 in
Accounts Receivable;
2. In excess of 1,000 traffic cases, 300 misdemeanor cases, 50 domestic relations cases and
l 00 Circuit Court civil and criminal cases are audited, inspected and maintained monthly
by the Accounting unit;
3. The Fiscal Services Division is responsible for collection of all past due and deferred
payment accounts and Oregon Department of Revenue accounts, other than for cases
assigned to judges for probation monitoring;
4. A substantial number of past due a\:counts which otherwise would be referred to a Judge
for disposition, which, in turn, may result in additional expense to the State in the form of
appearance fees and indigent defense legal representation, could be collected with
appropriate modifications in terms of payment or length ohime in which to pay the
account;
NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that the Trial Court Administrator and the
Fiscal Services Division of the Administrator's Office are delegated authority to adjust payment
terms and conditions for accounts receivable in the Fourth Judicial District from the date
originally due unless the obligation is otherwise satisfied or discharged by operation of law, and to
add or delete appropriate collection sanctions provided by law without further order of the court,
subject in any case to judicial review upon request by the judgment debtor.
IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that in the event the Court orders a hearing for failure to pay such
obligation, staff of the Fiscal Services Division shall be available to testify as to defendant's failure
to comply with payment terms and conditions.
